features.name: counter_comment_url_count
features.definition: How many URLs appear across all counter-argument comments?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list of strings; if missing or malformed return null; empty list returns 0. Sum over comments the number of regex matches of r'(https?://|www\.)[^\s)\]>]+' (case-insensitive), including markdown link targets. Raw text count, no semantic filtering; duplicates counted each time.

h0: counter_comment_url_count has no association with delta.
h1: Higher counter_comment_url_count is associated with higher probability of delta (OP view change).
note: Persuasiveness is operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (OP changed view). URL count is a mechanical proxy for evidence; it does not verify that links are evidence or relevant. Raw text may include outcome announcements or later replies; list order/timing unknown. Association only, not causal.
